0022600220.text: The Bulls (1-8) host the Spurs (9-2) in the 10th game of Chicago's season, sitting 14th in the East and 5.5 games back in the Central after losing seven straight, with a 0-3 home record. San Antonio is first in the Southwest and second in the West on a nine-game winning streak, has gone 5-0 on the road, and is missing Jayden Quaintance and Tobias Harris, while Devin Vassell is listed as day-to-day with a groin issue. Chicago is also without Caleb Wilson, Norman Powell, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins, all listed as day-to-day, and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Bulls lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026.
